messages:
maria: Heads-up — after yesterday's policy push, a subset of CI deploy jobs to runtime-gpu-2 started getting 403s when creating pods. Noticed around 02:10 UTC. Anyone else seeing failures?
kevin: I saw a spike in CI failures, came in as alerts. Quick grep of audit logs shows rbac denies for a deploy serviceaccount.
ops-bot: Audit log entry (2026-03-19T02:11:05Z): user=system:serviceaccount:ci:deploy-bot verb=create resource=pods namespace=runtime-gpu-2 status=403 reason=RBAC: access denied
sam: Repro'd locally: deploy-bot can list pods but cannot create. That smells like a ClusterRole -> Role binding mismatch after we scoped some cluster roles to namespaces.
natalie: Which PR was the scope change? I have @kevin's feature branch #4195 that tightened clusterrole:gpu-admin down to namespace roles. Might be missing the create verb for pods or missing subject in RoleBinding.
kevin: Yeah, PR 4195 converted gpu-admin -> gpu-namespace-admin and added tighter verbs. It included this Role snippet:```yaml
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: gpu-namespace-admin
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods", "pods/exec"]
  verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]
```
I pushed that to reduce blast radius but forgot to include "create" for pods used by the deploy workflow. Sorry.
maria: That explains it. The deploy job needs create + patch for pod templates. We should rollback the PR until we patch.
ryan: Quick mitigation: add a temporary RoleBinding granting deploy-bot a small create/patch on pods in runtime-gpu-2 only. I'll apply a scoped fix and then we can refine.
ops-bot: Applied RoleBinding runtime-gpu-2/ci-deploy-create-fix for subject system:serviceaccount:ci:deploy-bot (granted verbs: create, patch on pods).
kevin: Thanks. I'll update the PR to include the correct verbs and add a unit test that runs a dry-run create. Also adding a changelog note to call out verb reductions need deploy smoke.
sam: Can we also confirm this doesn't regress KMS unwrapping? Some of the role changes touched KMS decrypt permissions for node pools last month and I want to avoid cascade.
natalie: Good point — the KMS permissions are in a separate ClusterRole binding to the infra-kms-sa. This change didn't touch that binding, but I'll run a quick audit: `kubectl get rolebinding -A --field-selector metadata.name=infra-kms-sa` and check audit trails after.
kevin: Action items: 1) rollback PR 4195 (done), 2) push corrected Role with verbs [get,list,watch,create,patch] + test (in flight), 3) add CI dry-run smoke for any RBAC refactor (kevin).
maria: Also file an incident note with timeline and the audit snippet — ops, please attach the exact audit lines.
ops-bot: Incident saved: INC-2026-0319-01, severity=low-medium, impacted namespaces=runtime-gpu-2, initial-fix=namespace-scoped rolebinding.
ryan: After the fix we should add an automated check that simulates deploy-bot life-cycle (create pod, exec) when an RBAC PR changes roles referenced by ci. I'll draft a GH action.
maria: Thanks all. No customer impact reported, just CI flakes. We'll close the incident after postmortem and adding the CI smoke test. :white_check_mark:
